reserves.name: Fasanara F-ONE private-credit and digital-asset strategy NAV

reserveReview.rationale: Midas describes mF-ONE as exposure to Fasanara private-credit and digital-asset strategies. The September 11 aggregate proof-of-reserve view and operational wallet listings do not disclose underlying facility or asset weights. The reserve remains one unresolved strategy envelope without invented borrower, asset or venue allocations.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Midas mF-ONE product disclosure and strategy description
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Midas identifies the Fasanara strategy and its broad private-credit and digital-asset mandate, but does not publish a current facility-level allocation, borrower concentration, maturity schedule, or custody breakdown in the reviewed sources.
